# game

`game.cpp`, `game.hpp`, `structs.hpp`, `symbols.hpp`, `dvars.cpp`, and `dvars.hpp` define the `game` namespace ABI, fixed-address engine bindings, runtime bridge APIs, and console-variable registration layer for `jb_mp_s.dll`.

## Contents

- [dvars.cpp](./dvars.cpp) implements `dvars::component`, dvar formatting, typed registration wrappers, override registries, replacement helpers, and scheduler-driven lifecycle management.

- [dvars.hpp](./dvars.hpp) declares `dvar_info`, `dvar_map`, cached `game::dvar_s*` handles, `dvar_spec`, typed registration functions, replacement APIs, and `overrides` registries.

- [game.cpp](./game.cpp) implements `game_offset`, command and input bridges, asset enumeration, scripting calls, rendering lookups, dvar lookup, and engine API wrappers.

- [game.hpp](./game.hpp) declares `mp_dll`, `symbol<T>`, command APIs, asset APIs, rendering lookups, scripting APIs, dvar APIs, and engine bridge functions.

- [structs.hpp](./structs.hpp) defines ABI-sensitive `game` structs and enums for assets, rendering, UI, expressions, dvars, scripting, input, clients, entities, and player state.

- [symbols.hpp](./symbols.hpp) binds `Com_Printf`, `DB_FindXAssetHeader`, `Dvar_RegisterNew`, renderer functions, scripting functions, server functions, command state, asset state, dvar state, and UI state through `symbol<T>`.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`game_offset()` resolves `jb_mp_s.dll` and rebases fixed IDA addresses; `symbol<T>` exposes rebased functions and globals; `game.cpp` wraps engine calls; `dvars.cpp` registers or replaces dvars through `game::Dvar_RegisterNew` and `game::Dvar_FindVar`.

`dvars::component::post_load()` installs override metadata, schedules main-thread dvar creation, reapplies UI dvars every `250ms`, and clears selected cached handles during `scheduler::on_shutdown`.

`DB_EnumXAssetEntries()` traverses `db_hashTable`, `g_assetEntryPool`, `nextHash`, and `nextOverride` while holding the engine asset lock and invoking a caller-provided callback.

## Patterns

`symbol<T>` uses address-bound wrappers with `get()`, pointer conversion, and `operator->()` for engine symbols.

`dvar_spec` separates type, name, description, flags, value, and domain so `register_dvar`, `replace_dvar`, and `replace_dvar_at` can share typed registration behavior.

`Dvar_RegisterFloat`, `Dvar_RegisterVec4`, `Dvar_RegisterBool`, `Dvar_RegisterInt`, and `Dvar_RegisterString` construct `DvarValue` and `DvarLimits` before calling `game::Dvar_RegisterNew`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`game_offset(uintptr_t ida_address)` requires a loaded `jb_mp_s.dll` and computes `ida_address - 0x10000000 + reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mp_dll)`.

`dvar_get_vector_domain()` emits `Domain is any %iD vector`, `Domain is any %iD vector with components %g or smaller`, `Domain is any %iD vector with components %g or bigger`, or `Domain is any %iD vector with components from %g to %g`.

`dvar_get_domain()` emits `Domain is 0 or 1`, `Domain is any number`, `Domain is any integer`, `Domain is any 4-component color, in RGBA format`, `Domain is any text`, or `unhandled dvar type '%i'`.

`dvar_value_to_string()` serializes booleans as `true` or `false`, floats with `%g`, integers with `%d`, strings as `"\"%s\""`, and unsupported types as `<?>`.

`Dvar_ValueToString()` invokes engine address `game::game_offset(0x10274F80)` through x86 inline assembly and returns an engine-owned `char*`.

`DB_EnumXAssetEntries()` scans exactly `0x9C40` hash buckets, waits while `0x105624F8` is nonzero, and sleeps for `1ms` between lock checks.

`dvar_s` requires `type==12`, `modified==13`, `current==16`, `latched==32`, `reset==48`, and `domain==64`; `Material` requires `sizeof(Material)==104`; `windowDef_t` requires `sizeof(windowDef_t)==168`; `menuDef_t` requires `sizeof(menuDef_t)==308`; `usercmd_t` requires `sizeof(usercmd_t)==0x2C`; and `entity_t` requires `sizeof(entity_t)==0x290`.

## Configuration and ABI

`DvarType`, `dvar_type`, `DvarValue`, `DvarLimits`, `dvar_flags`, and `dvar_s` define the engine dvar ABI, including `DVAR_TYPE_BOOL`, `DVAR_TYPE_INT`, `DVAR_TYPE_FLOAT`, `DVAR_TYPE_STRING`, `saved`, `write_protected`, `latched`, and `read_only`.

`XAssetHeader`, `DvarValue`, `DvarLimits`, `VariableUnion`, `itemDefData_t`, `GfxDrawSurf`, and `GfxStateBits` require correct active-union context.

`Material`, `windowDef_t`, `menuDef_t`, `playerState_t`, `entity_t`, and `client_t` preserve binary layout through field order, packing, padding, pointer width, and documented offsets.
